scope: frozen RL representation observation only; no intervention
reference_admission: all 2288 baseline score<0.7, no original GT quality gate
label_timing: complete denoising then official rescore, immediately before quality analysis
pilot_sampling: up to 8 per baseline primary mode, exploratory sessions only; prioritize distinct sessions
formal_timestep_status: candidate grid, confirm after pilot quality/coverage/throughput; no representation-based selection
noise_generator: torch.Generator(device=cpu), standard normal float32 (1,8,3), then transfer; save actual tensors
pairing: same initial epsilon and same subsequent step epsilon in both branches; shared bank across start levels
continuation: start at exact original DDIM index matching t; call unchanged p_mean_variance(deterministic=False); eta=1; original std/epsilon/final clipping
conditioning: same verified feature input and shared frozen feature/history/status projections, batch=1
layers: action_encoder pre position, condition_fusion, each DiT block, DiT final_layer
steps: all actually executed steps; no synthetic padding
split_unit: collection session, grouped across log segments
pilot_revision_reason: t20/40/80 final quality collapsed across initializations; complete native schedule grid including lowest t0 before formal decision
